reviews.text: Everything was perfect! The ideal grooming salon and the staff were lovely. My new go-to place for my dog.
So far, so good. Very professional, friendly, and efficient service.
Spectacular! I took my dog ​​Duna and they groomed her exactly as I wanted. It's the first time I've been so happy with a place. 100% recommended
Kima went for a bath and it turned out great, everyone was very nice!!

Snoopy went to the bathroom and had a great time, and he looked so cute!
They also gave him an ultrasonic dental cleaning, and the result was incredible!!!! Highly recommended!!!!
I don't have a before picture, but he had yellow tartar, and the difference was a pleasant surprise.
And the service from all the staff was superb—very friendly and careful…we'll definitely be back!
I walked by and booked a place to try it out, and we'll definitely be back. They were very friendly and attentive to the dogs, and did a great job. 100% recommended.
Yesterday we took our 2 dogs and they came out shiny and super clean. Very friendly staff! A great find! We will definitely be back

Gordon came out of his grooming session looking gorgeous and very happy!
The owner, the groomer, and the rest of the staff were all lovely and very caring with him. They explained everything perfectly and made me feel very comfortable from the start.

But above all, I would highlight the care they give to the dogs. You can really tell they love animals and are attentive to making sure they feel comfortable and relaxed. For me, that's essential when I leave Gordon in someone else's hands.

Without a doubt, a very good experience and a place we will definitely return to. Highly recommended!
I took my dog ​​Pi there for a few hours and the service was excellent. Highly recommended.

Finally, a place like this in Barcelona! I love the space; I took my dog ​​to the groomer and they made him look adorable, and I also took the opportunity to buy the dog food we both love! We'll definitely be back.
Highly recommended. Excellent treatment of dogs! I highly recommend it.

I have a dog with separation anxiety and I can never leave him alone. Having this service so close by is incredibly convenient because I can leave him there when I have errands to run. The service is exceptional and I feel completely at ease leaving him there. Thank you for your dedication!
I took my dog ​​to get bathed, excellent service and a very nice atmosphere!

I've taken my poodle there a couple of times because I needed to run some errands, and he had a great time. They're very professional and caring. I'm looking forward to trying their grooming service because the dogs leave looking fantastic. I love having this daycare in the neighborhood.
The hairdressing experience was great. My dog ​​came out prettier than ever. The staff is professional, very friendly and attentive. We really enjoyed it and will be back!

I tried the stripping grooming service and I'm very happy with the results. My dachshund is quite nervous around new people, but she was still very pleased with the team. I highly recommend it and we'll definitely be back!
I took my Maltese to the nursery trial and he was very happy; I've already signed him up. The staff are very professional and know what they're talking about.

Amazing!! My baby came out looking sharp and super happy!! Now it's my princess's turn, I'm sure it will be just as wonderful! They treat our furry friends with so much love and it shows!

❣️
Impeccable grooming service for my long-haired, rather anxious dachshund 🤩🤩🤩🤩! The team is very friendly and attentive 🥰. A bit pricey considering the regular price without the opening promotion. …

We took our dog to the grooming service and we are very happy with the result. They left her looking very pretty, the treatment was excellent and the facilities are very good. Without a doubt, from now on we will always take her here. Highly recommended!
Very good attention and service at the dog grooming salon. I took my Maltipoo puppy for his first cut and he was left looking so cute! Very good experience, we definitely have hair for Mousse!!!
Our dog loved it so much she tried to go there at night!
Just what the neighborhood needed, finally! A quality hair salon and the daycare service is fantastic, the open-plan space is amazing! Highly recommended.
Very good experience
